title: Golden Hour Citrus Breeze

diffuser.notes: Add to a diffuser with water for a fresh, uplifting room scent.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; spray lightly in the air.

why_it_works: Sweet orange lifts the mood with a sun-kissed aroma, lavender calms the heat of the day, and a hint of peppermint adds a cooling, refreshing edge—perfect for late-summer evenings.
safety: Patch test before topical use; dilute properly.
Avoid eyes and mucous membranes; keep out of reach of children and pets.
Consult a healthcare professional if pregnant, nursing, or under medical care.
